summary: Spec fidelity (brief F1/F4, spec 11.7 step 6, 11.11; scenarios atip.batchpointers.01, .04): an invalid CANON_ROLE is a stateless step-6 check (the brief of canon-0-35-canon-check-order makes it a validator), but in a batch the parent does not run it: the children do. Real binary: CANON_ROLE=bogus canon finding close --input '[valid,valid]' -> exit 1 BATCH_INCOMPLETE field /0, items [failed UNKNOWN_ROLE, skipped]; a single document gives exit 2 UNKNOWN_ROLE field CANON_ROLE, and a batch whose later item has a domain fault gives that item's exit 2 (/1/round). The contract's preflight (every item through steps 1-6 before any runs, exit 2, no data) would answer the first. Same shape in 0.34 (BATCH_INCOMPLETE field CANON_ROLE), so not a regression; nothing runs because the element-0 child fails first, so the blast radius is the code and exit value only. L2.batch-preflight does not set CANON_ROLE.
